items: The mirror images `DLC2EncSeeker01Mirror` 028E82:Dragonborn.esm (21), `DLC2EncSeeker02Mirror` 02856B:Dragonborn.esm (32) and `DLC2EncSeeker03Mirror` 028E86:Dragonborn.esm (42) use their rung as a template but set their own level, so changing a rung does not move its mirror (under Placed only).
`DLC2EncSeeker02` and `03` template `DLC2EncSeeker01` without `Stats`, so they keep their own level when 01 changes.
Every other Seeker record (the `NoScript` leaves, `DLC2MQ02Seeker`, the `DLC2SummonSeeker`, `DLC2SummonSeekerHigh` and `ccPEWSSE002_SummonSeeker` summons) carries `Stats` and follows its template.
